g.aria-label: Same source and prepared glyphs. Both columns use an 18px font.

A paragraph now answers a width offer with real glyph measurements. The words reflow, while the font size stays at 18 pixels. Styled runs share the same baseline, and the prepared text is reused for each allocation.
